name: the-ripper
description: The Ripper — producer tool: link/WAV/MP3 -> beat grid -> chops, stems, drag-to-DAW

scripts.lint: npm run lint -w ui && npm run lint -w desktop
scripts.test: npm run test:engine && npm run test:ui && npm run test:desktop && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build -w ui && npm run e2e -w desktop
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && npm run build:engine && npm run dist:mac -w desktop
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npm run build:engine && npm run dist:win -w desktop
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && npm run build:engine && npm run dist:linux -w desktop
